subject.title: feat(agents): canonical agent creation with Custodian hatch flow

question: Should the new Control UI/Custodian agent-creation and hatch experience be accepted as a supported core workflow once the restart regression and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: This is a new user-facing core workflow spanning gateway protocol, agent lifecycle, Custodian behavior, and Control UI navigation; correctness fixes do not establish permanent product-scope acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the core flow
options.body: Keep the feature in core, require the narrow restart-policy repair and redacted real UI proof, then continue normal compatibility review.

options.title: Narrow to creation-path refactor
options.body: Land only a compatibility-preserving canonical creation service and defer the Custodian/UI hatch experience to a separately sponsored design.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR if the new first-class agent-creation UX is not currently desired in the core product.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core flow
recommendation.body: Keep the feature in core, require the narrow restart-policy repair and redacted real UI proof, then continue normal compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed workflow and its main implementation commits are attributed to steipete in the supplied PR history.
